name: Acuity Scheduling
description: Acuity Scheduling is an online appointment booking platform, owned by Squarespace, that lets service-based businesses manage bookings, payments, and reminders on branded booking pages.
best_for: Solo practitioners and service businesses in beauty, fitness, wellness, education, and consulting who need 24/7 client self-booking.
features: Calendar sync with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and iCloud
Automated email and text reminders to reduce no-shows
Class and group scheduling with multiple attendees
Integrations with Stripe, Square, PayPal, and Zoom

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that lets people share availability links to book meetings without back-and-forth emails.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and teams booking one-off or recurring meetings

alternatives.name: Setmore
alternatives.description: A free online appointment scheduling platform with booking pages, payments, and reminders.
alternatives.best_for: Small service businesses wanting a free booking solution

alternatives.name: Cal.com
alternatives.description: An open-source scheduling infrastructure platform for building booking flows.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and businesses wanting customizable, self-hostable scheduling

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: $27/month billed annually ($34 monthly); up to 6 calendars, payments, reminders, intake forms, waitlist, memberships and packages.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: $49/month billed annually ($61 monthly); up to 36 calendars.
